text:
lin: Noticing a spike in SCIM errors for our customer tenant 'acme' since 04:05 UTC. Onboarding flow shows failures at user sync step. 500s and a few 401s.

talia: What do logs show from the token introspection path?

lin: Sample error from scim-service logs: `ERROR auth/introspect.go:142 - introspect failed: 401 unauthorized: invalid signature (missing kid)`

omar: Missing kid means the assertion/jwt didn't map to a JWKS key. Did we change key rotation policy last night? Ops mentioned a KMS alias migration.

infra-bot: [kms] 2025-03-20T04:03:12Z - alias-update - user=ops - alias=redwood/idp-sign - newKey=arn:aws:kms:...:key/3f12 - request_id=kk-9901

lin: Also saw an IAM policy push around same time: `svc-scim-cache` role had secrets:read removed by infra-cfn change.

omar: If the cache can't read the jwks secret, it may be serving a stale JWKS without the rotated kid. Two fixes: regrant read or rotate JWKS to include both kids and use fallback. Which is lower blast?

talia: Regranting is quick but needs approval from infra-oncall. Fallback in proxy is a 10m code + deploy and lower risk. I'll page oncall.

ops: infra-oncall here. I can re-add `secrets.read` for svc-scim-cache right now if the change ID is known. Which change removed it?

lin: Change was CFN stack infra-acl update, change-id cfn-90233 by infra-bot at 04:02:40Z.

ops: Reapplied a policy patch restoring secrets.read to svc-scim-cache. Should be effective within seconds.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2025-03-20T04:07:05Z - iam-policy-mod - actor=infra-bot - resource=role/svc-scim-cache - diff="-secrets.read" -> notification sent to #security.

lin: After regrant, scim-service started succeeding for a subset. Error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% in the first 5 min.

omar: Good. Still want to make the JWKS rotation safer. Proposal: proxy serves two entries in jwks.json for 72h after rotation and we generate an alert if jwks does not include the latest kid within 2m of KMS alias change.

talia: Also propose runbook update: when rotating KMS keys (rekey/rewrap), coordinate three steps: 1) rotate key, 2) publish new kid to JWKS, 3) ensure svc-scim-cache read access. Add gating such that steps 2/3 must be executed before step 1 marked complete.

lin: Can we retroactively check for older tokens signed with the previous kid? Might need to invalidate long-lived SCIM tokens.

ops: We'll issue a token rotation for the SCIM service account. Rolling out token refresh now; will re-encrypt with new KMS key and update DB. ETA 15m.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2025-03-20T04:12:22Z - kms-rotate - actor=ops - alias=redwood/idp-sign - priorKey=arn:.../key/7a9b - newKey=arn:.../key/3f12 - request_id=kk-9901

omar: Add a one-off alert rule: scim.provision.errors > 5% for 5m -> pager to eng-sre. Also add a dashboard panel showing jwks.kids vs kms.alias.lastRotation.

lin: Filing tickets: sec-4456 (postmortem + compliance package), infra-4457 (CFN change validation), devex-4458 (runbook and staging rehearse).

ops: All clear on the token swap; provisioning success rate back to normal for acme tenant. Will run a staged key rotate in staging following the new checklist before attempting any more prod rotations.

talia: Thanks everyone. Closing this slack thread but keep the audit bundle in the postmortem ticket.

lin: One more note: add a pre-rotation CI check that validates JWKS contains the future kid when we schedule a rotation. That should catch this class of error earlier.

ops: Acknowledged. Will add to infra backlog.
